request: tasbeeh counter big button, target 33, 99 or 100
program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads ocean
table zikr phrase pick SubhanAllah|Alhamdulillah|AllahuAkbar = SubhanAllah
setting target num = 33 "Count to"
state ph text = SubhanAllah
let n = count(zikr today where phrase = ph)
row gap 1
  each options zikr.phrase
    button it fill if(ph = it, accent, soft) tap set ph = it
draw width 240 tap add zikr phrase = ph
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
when n > 0 and n % target = 0 notify "Round complete"
"Tap the circle to count." count(zikr today) "today in all." faint
describe:
Tasbeeh, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- zikr: phrase: one of SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, AllahuAkbar, starts at SubhanAllah. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Count to": number, starts at 33.
Works out:
- n is how many zikr entries today where phrase is ph.
Remembers while you use it: ph, starting at SubhanAllah.
Shows:
- for each choice of the phrase of the zikr:
  - a button the choice; a tap sets ph to the choice.
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a zikr with phrase set to ph.
- when n is more than 0 and n leaves over when divided by target is 0, it shows the notice "Round complete".
- text: "Tap the circle to count.", how many zikr entries today, "today in all.".

request: deploy checklist for prod release: run tests, db backup, migrate, deploy, smoke test, notify team. tick each, then a reset button for next release.

program:
app " Deployments" cloud ocean
table deploy_out name text, target_on date, status pick Pro|Deploy|Smoke|Rest = Pro
each deploy_out where status = Pro sort at as o
  row card tap edit o
    stack grow
      o.name bold
      o.target_on faint
    o.status bold
    button " Restore" tap set o.status = Rest
"Count to" count(deploy_out) "deployments," count(deploy_out where status = Smoke) "smoke" faint
form deploy_out, "New deployment"
describe:
Deployments, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- deploy out: name: text; target on: date; status: one of Pro, Deploy, Smoke, Rest, starts at Pro. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each deploy out where status is Pro sorted by at:
  - a group; a tap opens the deploy out for editing:
    - text: the name of the deploy out.
    - text: the target on of the deploy out.
    - text: the status of the deploy out.
    - a button " Restore"; a tap sets the status of the deploy out to Rest.
- text: "Count to", how many deploy out entries, "deployments,", how many deploy out entries where status is Smoke, "smoke".
- a form to add a deploy out.

program:
app "Bug log" bolt slate
table bug title text, sev pick Low|Medium|High = Medium, fixed bool
count(bug where fixed = no) "open bugs" big

each bug where fixed = no sort at as b

  - a group; a tap opens the bug for editing; a swipe removes the bug, with undo:
    - a tick box for the fixed of the bug.
    - text: the title of the bug.
    - text: the sev of the bug.
- text: "Fixed this week", how many bug entries this week where fixed is yes.

request: quiz with 5 questions on general knowledge, multiple choice, shows score at the end

checklist.item: shows a question with multiple choice options
tapping an option records the answer
shows correct/incorrect feedback or final score

program:
app "GK quiz" star plum
table q topic pick Sports|History|Science|Other = Other, ask text, a text, b text, c text, right pick A|B|C
table got q ref q, ok bool
let score = count(got where ok = yes)
"Score" score "of" count(got) big
each q as x
  if count(x.got) = 0
    stack card gap 1
      x.ask head
      button x.a tap add got q = x, ok = (x.right = A)
      button x.b tap add got q = x, ok = (x.right = B)
      button x.c tap add got q = x, ok = (x.right = C)
form q, "Add question"
button "Play again" tap remove all got
describe:
GK quiz, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- q: topic: one of Sports, History, Science, Other, starts at Other; ask: text; a: text; b: text; c: text; right: one of A, B, C. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- got: q: a q; ok: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- score is how many got entries where ok is yes.
Shows:
- text: "Score", score, "of", how many got entries.
- for each q:
  - if how many the q's got entries is 0:
    - text: the ask of the q.
    - a button the a of the q; a tap adds a got with q set to the q, ok set to the result of the right of the q is A.
    - a button the b of the q; a tap adds a got with q set to the q, ok set to the result of the right of the q is B.
    - a button the c of the q; a tap adds a got with q set to the q, ok set to the result of the right of the q is C.
- a form to add a q.
- a button "Play again"; a tap removes all got entries, with one undo.

request: generator diesel tank picture that empties as I log hours run. tank is 20 litres, uses 1.5 L an hour, refill button

checklist.item: shows a visual tank or fill meter
shows litres left based on 1.5 L per hour from 20 L

program:
app "Tank" bolt ocean
table refilled liters num 1..20
let km = sum(refilled.liters)
let used = sum(refilled.liters) - first(refilled.liters)
"Ramps" round(km / used) "L per head" big
"Spent" used "L" head
"Days since last refill" used - since(refilled) "days" faint
draw 90, 100 width 260
  rect 5, 5, 50, 90 stroke ink thick 2
  rect 6, 94 - 88 * clamp(km / used, 0, 1), 8, 88 * clamp(km / used, 0, 1) fill accent opacity 0.7
  km "L" bold
  "Spent" used "L" head
form refilled, "Add refilled"
list refilled by day
describe:
Tank, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- refilled: liters: number, 1 to 20. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- km is the total liters of refilled.
- used is the total liters of refilled minus the first liters of refilled.
Shows:
- text: "Ramps", km divided by used rounded, "L per head".
- text: "Spent", used, "L".
- text: "Days since last refill", used minus days since the last of refilled entries, "days".
- a drawing made of rectangles.
- a form to add a refilled.
- a list of refilled by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

request: Hajj savings goal 750000 rs. I deposit whenever I can. show progress bar and how much left

program:
app "Hajj" mosque mint
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting goal money = 750000 "Hajj target"
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let p = clamp(total / goal, 0, 1)
row gap 3
  draw 40, 120 width 60
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow
    total big
    round(p * 100) "% of" goal faint tap edit goal
    "Goal" goal "faint" faint tap edit goal
quick deposit, amount, [500, 1000, 2000]
form deposit
list deposit by day
describe:
Hajj, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- deposit: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Hajj target": money, starts at 750000.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of deposit.
- p is total divided by goal kept between 0 and 1.
Shows:
- a drawing made of rectangles, circles.
- text: total.
- text: p times 100 rounded, "% of", goal; a tap opens goal for editing.
- text: "Goal", goal, "faint"; a tap opens goal for editing.
- one-tap buttons that add a deposit with amount set to each of 500, 1000, 2000.
- a form to add a deposit.
- a list of deposit by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
